svg.text: Campus Events Ticketing System - Class Diagram
• User, Student, Organizer, Administrator - User hierarchy with role-based access
• Event - Core entity representing campus events
• Ticket - Represents claimed tickets with QR codes
• Business logic and data access separated from presentation
• Each service handles specific domain responsibilities
• Services interact with Firebase Firestore collections
Total Classes: 15 (6 Domain Models + 9 Services) | Architecture: Firebase-based MVC with Service Layer
File: class_diagram.svg | Implementation: JavaScript ES6 Modules + Firebase Firestore
